CTA.titlePrefix: Ready to secure your assets with
CTA.description: Open your private multi-currency vault in minutes. Hardened with cryptographic two-factor authentication and real-time device auditing.

FAQ.description: Everything you need to know about our cryptographic private vaults, security protocols, and multi-currency ledgers.
FAQ.q1: How are my multi-currency assets protected in private vaults?
FAQ.a1: All private vaults are secured using military-grade AES-256 encryption combined with hardware-backed cryptographic keys. Assets are isolated within multi-region liquidity nodes with real-time device auditing.
FAQ.q2: What security measures are required during account setup?
FAQ.a2: Apex Bank requires time-based one-time password (TOTP) two-factor authentication (2FA) via authenticator apps, device fingerprinting, and cryptographically verified sessions for every transaction.
FAQ.q3: How fast are international currency swaps and transfers?
FAQ.a3: Multi-currency cash ledgers settle instantly within your internal vault network. External institutional wire settlements process through dedicated global banking nodes with real-time tracking.
FAQ.q4: Can I manage institutional sub-accounts and permissions?
FAQ.a4: Yes. Enterprise and institutional profiles support custom role-based access control (RBAC), allowing you to assign specific multi-signature and auditing privileges to team members.

Features.description: Discover the core protocols and banking architecture designed to safeguard your private vaults and institutional assets.
Features.f1Desc: Advanced TOTP verification workflows coupled with custom authorization checkpoints protecting every session.
Features.f2Desc: Seamless real-time cash positioning and balance management across USD, EUR, and global asset ledgers.
Features.f3Desc: Real-time device parsing, IP logging, and session tracking ensuring complete transparency and accountability.

Hero.description: Take full control of multi-currency cash positioning and real-time ledger auditing. Hardened with cryptographic two-factor security for absolute privacy.

OnboardingSteps.description: Get started with Apex Bank in three structured, cryptographically protected steps.
OnboardingSteps.s1Desc: Register your institutional or private account in minutes with encrypted credentials.
OnboardingSteps.s2Desc: Scan your authenticator QR code to harden your session with multi-factor security.
OnboardingSteps.s3Desc: Manage multi-currency cash ledgers and monitor real-time device audit trails.

SecurityOverview.description: Apex Bank implements rigorous security layers and multi-factor authorization checkpoints designed to ensure your private financial assets remain completely protected.
SecurityOverview.p1Desc: Passwords are protected using industry-standard bcrypt encryption hashing to safeguard user accounts against unauthorized access attempts.
SecurityOverview.p2Desc: Enforce multi-factor authentication with 6-digit authenticator codes required at every login session challenge point.
SecurityOverview.p3Desc: Automated user agent parsing and secure IP address tracking record every login session for total accountability and transparency.
SecurityOverview.p4Desc: Custom credentials sign-in error handling and JWT strategy patterns prevent token leaks and secure protected vault routes.
